name: Whitecurrant
grown_as: A fruit bush, 'White Versailles', the white-fruited form of redcurrant. Usually grown on a short leg (a clear stem of 10 to 15 cm) as an open goblet, or as a cordon.
habit: An upright, spineless deciduous shrub, 1 to 1.5 m, on a short single trunk branching into an open cup of stems. Not aromatic. Fruits on short spurs on older wood and at the base of last year's shoots.

leaf.outline: Roundish, 4 to 7 cm across, with three to five broad lobes
leaf.tip: Each lobe broad and bluntly pointed
leaf.margin: Coarse, rounded to bluntly pointed teeth all round
leaf.veins: Three to five main veins from the top of the stalk, one into each lobe
leaf.surface: Smooth, mid green, slightly glossy above; paler and smooth or faintly downy beneath; no glands or smell

flower.petals: Five tiny petals hardly seen; the visible flower is five broad sepals spread flat
flower.colour: Pale yellow-green, sometimes with a purplish-brown ring in the centre
flower.centre: A raised ring (disc) with five short stamens and a two-branched style
flower.behind: A small green ovary behind the saucer, which becomes the berry
flower.carried: Ten to twenty on long hanging strings (strigs) 5 to 10 cm, several from each spur among the young leaves

fruit: Round, translucent berries, 8 to 10 mm, pearly white to pale cream-yellow when ripe, the pale lines of veins and the seeds showing faintly through the skin, each with a tiny brown dry tip. Ten to twenty on long hanging strigs, ripest at the top. July.
seedling: Not drawn: grown from cuttings or bought plants
winter: Bare open goblet on a short leg: pale grey-brown stems, with short spurs and pointed brown buds standing away from the stem.

leaf: roundish leaf with three to five broad lobes
main veins fanning from a long stalk
bloom: a tiny flat pale green saucer flower
part of a long hanging string
young: a bush on a short single trunk, branching into an open cup
dormant: bare open goblet of pale stems on a short single trunk
flower: long hanging strings of tiny pale green saucer flowers
crop: long hanging strings of round translucent pearly-white berries

look_alikes: Redcurrant is the same plant with red berries. Blackcurrant leaves are bigger, more pointed and smell strongly, with bell flowers and black berries. Gooseberry has spines and berries borne singly.
